cards.title: The slowest drive-thru
cards.prompt: The world's slowest drive-thru. The speaker is very interested in your day.
cards.tip: Order something specific, then make the wait stranger.

cards.title: Lawn chairs on the moon
cards.prompt: Two lawn chairs on the moon. The Earth is up. Nobody packed snacks.
cards.tip: Play it like an ordinary picnic that happens to be in space.

cards.title: One room left
cards.prompt: A hotel lobby at midnight. One room left.
cards.tip: Want the room. Stay fond of each other.

cards.title: The quiet car
cards.prompt: The quiet car of a train. Something must be discussed urgently.
cards.tip: Whisper the scandal. Let it grow.

cards.title: Lost and found
cards.prompt: The lost-and-found office at a theme park, closing time.
cards.tip: Name one lost thing. Make it matter to someone.

cards.title: Ferris wheel, stuck
cards.prompt: The top of a Ferris wheel that has stopped. You can see the whole fair.
cards.tip: You are safe. The tilt is for drama.

cards.title: Gate 99
cards.prompt: An airport gate. The flight leaves "whenever". Nobody agrees what that means.
cards.tip: Name the destination in the first two lines.

cards.title: Backstage
cards.prompt: Backstage at the school play, one minute before curtain.
cards.tip: Something is missing. It is a puzzle, not a disaster.

cards.title: Polite pirate
cards.prompt: The world's most polite pirate, who wants the treasure without being rude.
cards.tip: Say please while doing something pirate-shaped.

cards.title: Retired hero
cards.prompt: A retired superhero who wants everyone to notice they still have it.
cards.tip: Their only power left is finding snacks.

cards.title: Next Tuesday
cards.prompt: A time traveler from next Tuesday who must not spoil anything.
cards.tip: Almost spoil something small. Then stop.

cards.title: Opinionated GPS
cards.prompt: A GPS with strong opinions, who wants you to take the scenic route.
cards.tip: Give directions that are really life advice.

cards.title: Secret royalty
cards.prompt: Royalty in disguise, who wants one ordinary afternoon.
cards.tip: A royal habit keeps leaking out.

cards.title: Detective, no case
cards.prompt: A detective who wants a mystery so badly they'll solve anything.
cards.tip: Investigate a fact everyone already knows.

cards.title: Vegetarian dragon
cards.prompt: A dragon trying very hard to be vegetarian, who wants everyone's approval.
cards.tip: Proud, not ashamed. Play the effort.

cards.title: The new manager
cards.prompt: A brand-new manager on day one, who wants to seem like they've done this before.
cards.tip: Give one confident instruction that makes no sense.

cards.title: Yes, and
cards.prompt: Every line starts with “Yes, and…” then adds one new thing.
cards.tip: Accept first. Then build.

cards.title: Questions only
cards.prompt: Every line must be a question. The scene still has to move.
cards.tip: A question can smuggle a fact in.

cards.title: Fortunately
cards.prompt: Lines take turns starting with Fortunately and Unfortunately.
cards.tip: Complicate the last fact. Never erase it.

cards.title: Last word first
cards.prompt: Start your line with the last word the previous person said.
cards.tip: You can't plan ahead. You have to listen.

cards.title: Nature documentary
cards.prompt: Narrate yourselves like a hushed nature documentary.
cards.tip: Hushed. Amazed. Specific. The species is you.

cards.title: Three words
cards.prompt: Every line is exactly three words.
cards.tip: Three words can still yes-and.

cards.title: Polite fury
cards.prompt: Everyone is boiling with politeness. Nobody raises their voice.
cards.tip: Thank people while refusing to budge.

cards.title: Alphabet
cards.prompt: Each line starts with the next letter of the alphabet.
cards.tip: Names and sounds count. Apple. Bang.

cards.title: Best news ever
cards.prompt: Someone just got the best news of their life. Who?

cards.title: Very sleepy
cards.prompt: Everyone is suddenly very, very sleepy.

cards.title: Status flip
cards.prompt: Whoever is in charge is now nervous. The nervous one takes over.

cards.title: Secret revealed
cards.prompt: One of you has been hiding a harmless secret. Reveal it now.

cards.title: One-word story
cards.prompt: Tell a story one word each, around the group. End with “The end.”
cards.tip: Say a word you can picture. “And” is legal.

cards.title: Fortunately
cards.prompt: Swing a story between Fortunately and Unfortunately, one line each.
cards.tip: Unfortunately complicates. It never deletes.

seeds: We left the house on time.

cards.title: The expert
cards.prompt: One player is the world expert on a ridiculous subject. Everyone else interviews them.
cards.tip: No wrong facts. Only facts said with authority.

cards.title: Half-Life
cards.prompt: Tell a tiny story together. Then retell it in half the time. Then half again.
cards.tip: Keep the best bits. Drop everything else.

cards.title: Emotional forecast
cards.prompt: Everyone says the same ordinary line, each in a new feeling.
cards.tip: The words stay. The feeling changes.
